content: Nightly jobs in docker compose: host crontab + docker compose exec -T works but env vars do not carry into exec, job logs vanish, TZ drift, schedule lives outside repo; cron inside app container is documented anti-pattern (no cron daemon in slim images, env/PID1/zombie issues); sidecar scheduler (supercronic crontab-compatible PID1, or ofelia docker-label jobs) keeps schedule versioned in compose at cost of one more container; dedicated backup container pattern also common. Verify backups actually produce restorable output.
